lines.text: Do you know how leafcutter ants move a whole tree? One small piece at a time.
Each ant snips a piece it can carry. It even vibrates while it cuts, which helps its jaws slice cleanly.
Then thousands of them march home along a cleared highway, each one carrying many times its own weight.
Tiny ants ride on top of the leaves, guarding the carriers from flies that attack them.
And they don't even eat the leaves. They feed them to a fungus garden underground, and eat the fungus.
Orbi moves big files the same way. Files up to twenty gigabytes go in parts of about thirty two megabytes, three at a time. If your connection drops, only the missing parts are sent again.
